title: freelancer Network Infrastructure & Structured Cabling Engineer
description:
Freelance Network Infrastructure & Structured Cabling Engineer

**Job Type:** Freelance / Project-Based  
**Location:** Mumbai / Malad West and nearby locations  
**Work Mode:** On-site (Customer Locations)  
**Experience:** Fresher / 0–1 Year / Freelancers  
**Payment:** Per Project / Per Visit / As Per Work Scope

Job Summary

We are looking for a Freelance Network Infrastructure & Structured Cabling Engineer to support network installation, structured cabling, maintenance, testing, and troubleshooting activities at various customer locations.

This opportunity is suitable for freshers, IT/networking students, and freelancers who are interested in gaining hands-on experience in network infrastructure and structured cabling projects.

The engineer will work on an assignment basis and assist with network cabling, rack installation, patch panel termination, switch installation, and basic network connectivity.

Key Responsibilities

* Install and maintain Cat5e, Cat6, and Cat6A network cables.
* Perform RJ45 termination, crimping, and punch-down activities.
* Install, dress, organize, and label patch panels, network racks, and cables.
* Assist with the installation and connectivity of network switches, routers, and Wireless Access Points (WAPs).
* Perform basic cable testing, continuity testing, and troubleshooting.
* Assist with fiber optic and copper cable installation and basic testing.
* Identify and resolve basic physical-layer network connectivity issues.
* Follow proper cable management, safety, and site-work practices.
* Maintain basic network infrastructure documentation and cable labeling records.
* Visit customer sites as per project requirements.

Required Skills

* Basic understanding of computer networking and TCP/IP.
* Knowledge of LAN, switches, routers, and Wi-Fi.
* Basic understanding of structured cabling.
* Familiarity with RJ45 crimping tools, punch-down tools, and cable testers is an advantage.
* Good communication and troubleshooting skills.
* Willingness to travel to customer locations.
* Ability to work independently and complete assigned tasks on time.

Eligibility

* Freshers and freelancers are welcome.
* Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech / B.Sc. / BCA / ITI in Networking, Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or a related field preferred.
* CCNA or basic networking certification is an advantage but not mandatory.
* Candidates with practical networking or cabling experience will be preferred.

Payment & Engagement

* Freelance / Project-Based assignments.
* Payment based on project scope, work requirements, or site visits.
* Opportunity to work on multiple networking and infrastructure projects.
* Regular project opportunities based on performance and availability.

Who Can Apply?

* Freshers looking for hands-on networking experience.
* Freelance network engineers.
* IT support technicians.
* Structured cabling technicians.
* Networking students with basic practical knowledge.

**Interested candidates can share their resume, contact details, and relevant networking or cabling experience to apply.**

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

**About the Job:**

*Kent is looking for an I&C Commissioning Engineerto be based in Shastri Marg, Vikhroli (West), Mumbai, India. The role of Completions, Commissioning, and Start-Up I&C Engineer for CCS India is responsible for functional support on all aspects of I&C commissioning to Kent projects globally. This position is required to support our Kent projects for implementation of best commissioning practices, standards, and processes.*

***Skills and Responsibilities***

* Demonstrate personnel HSSE and quality leadership, behaviour and guidance at all times.
* Apply strong Instrumentation & Control commissioning expertise to plan and deliver systems completion activities across FEED and detailed design phases, including the development and review of system boundaries, completion strategies, key commissioning documentation, and multidisciplinary commissioning inputs in line with Kent project requirements.
* Provides discipline technical support, oversight and advice on the Commissioning and Start-up of plant systems.
* Support population and maintenance of the Systems Completion Database and Planning interface for MC and Commissioning progress tracking, reporting certification, and quality purposes.
* Support development and management of commissioning online toolkit within the Kent CoE team containing all Completions, Commissioning, and Start-Up documentation including check sheets, commissioning man hour norm formulas, method statements, methodologies, procedures, and other commissioning templates in relation to a portfolio of Kent projects.
* Identify and manages discipline commissioning resource needs, tools, test equipment, plant, spares etc.
* Desirable experience with the implementation and development of commissioning digital tools inclusive but not limited to Hexagon Smart Completions / P6 integration to Hexagon Smart Completions and Power Bi Reporting, Automated SCDB data validation tool, CSU Sequence tool, and Smart Plant Auditing Tools (where applicable).
* Participate as I&C Commissioning Engineer during Commissionability reviews / audits on projects, compile reports detailing issues to be resolved, potential opportunities for optimisation to expedite commissioning.
* Stays up to date with advances in I&C and Telecoms commissioning fields including but not limited to new loop testing philosophy’s, DCS/SIS Testing, and new measurement & analytical techniques to ensure that such advances have been thoroughly proven prior to implementation on projects.
* Lead I&C discipline input during planning phases acting as the I&C interface point between project stakeholders such as vendors, engineering, operations, package management, and construction.
* Support and develop I&C discipline input to Systems Completion workshops during planning phases.
* Capture and apply lessons learned; participate in lessons learned reviews and provide input to close out reports

In addition to the responsibilities listed herein, the employee may be required to perform other ad-hoc tasks as needed or directed by the supervisor or management. These tasks will be within the reasonable scope of the employee's skills, capabilities, and role within the organization. The intent of this provision is to allow for flexibility and adaptability in meeting the dynamic needs of the organization, ensuring that operational requirements can be met efficiently. All such tasks will be assigned considering the employee's current workload and with respect to their professional development.

**Your knowledge/skills, education, and experience:**

* Instrumentation & Controls Engineering Degree.
* Typically, 5–10 years’ experience in project completions, I&C commissioning, and start up.
* Knowledge of Commissioning and Start-Up planning and preparation for I&C disciplines during FEED and detailed design phases.
* Proven strong technical skill in I&C discipline.
* Knowledge of project completion standards, specifications, codes, and appropriate safety criteria.
* Proven understanding of Project Planning, Project execution, Engineering, Construction, Commissioning & Completion practices in I&C fields.
* Exposure to several Oil Company practices, processes, and expectations with respect to Systems Completion, Preservation, Commissioning and Start Up operations.

**Communication:**

* Excellent oral and written communication and skills
* Strong coordination, communication, and problem-solving skills

**Behavior/ Core Competencies:**

* Leadership, Decision Making & Delegation
* Teamwork, Coordination, Planning and Organizing
* Flexibility / Adaptability
* Business Acumen, Client Focus
* Training and Mentoring & Innovation
* Working as per the Quality and Safety requirement & Standards.
* Cultural sensitivity and ability to work in a global, multicultural environment.
* Flexibility in working hours to accommodate different time zones.

**Software Tools**

* Go Technology/ ICAPS / Hexagon

**HSSEQ:**

The Employee shall observe the Health, Safety, Sustainability, Environment and Quality rules of the Company; it’s clients and the governing authorities of the host country.

* Candidate should contribute to creating a workplace where everyone feels compelled to intervene whenever they observe an unsafe act or condition to ensure that everyone goes home safe and well and the environment is preserved in the successful operation of our business.
* Candidate should maintain the HSSEQ management system, and the tools required to implement it.

title: Deputy Manager - Field Service Engineer - Mumbai
description:
Job Description:

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a hands-on **Deputy** **Field Service Manager** to lead and execute commissioning, testing, and troubleshooting of **SCADA and Substation Automation Systems** across Pan-India projects. The role demands strong technical proficiency in SCADA software (PSO, EPAS, Zenon), industrial communication protocols, and protection/automation systems, along with the ability to manage site deliverables, customer expectations, and cross-functional coordination.

**Key Responsibilities / Deliverables**

* **SCADA Commissioning & SAT**
* + Plan and conduct **commissioning, testing, and troubleshooting** of SCADA systems for substation automation projects using **PSO, EPAS, and Zenon**.
  + Perform **Site Acceptance Tests (SAT)**; prepare test procedures and reports.
* **Substation Automation & Protection Integration**
* + Configure and integrate **numerical relays** (Schneider, ABB, Siemens, GE) and verify protection I/O, GOOSE messaging, and HMI/SCADA mappings.
  + Validate **SAS architectures** including IED integration, bay-level controls, gateway engineering, and time synchronization.
* **Protocols & Communication**
* + Implement and troubleshoot **IEC 61850**, **Modbus RTU**, **Modbus TCP/IP**, **Profibus**, and **Ethernet/IP** networks, including VLANs, managed switches, and redundancy (RSTP/PRP/HSR where applicable).
* **PLC/RTU Engineering**
* + Develop, modify, and debug logic for **PLC (M580/M340)** and **RTU (Saitel/T500)**; perform point-to-point checks and interlocking validation.
* **Quality, Documentation & Compliance**
* + Maintain as-site documentation: architecture drawings, communication matrices, ICD/SCD/CID files, I/O lists, test sheets, method statements, and redlines markup.
  + Ensure compliance with utility standards, cybersecurity guidelines, and safety protocols.
* **Customer & Stakeholder Management**
* + Lead site execution, manage contractors, and act as the **primary technical interface** with customers (utilities, EPCs, end users).
  + Provide **on-site training** and knowledge transfer to customer teams.
* **Issue Resolution & Escalation**
* + Drive root cause analysis, corrective/preventive actions, and coordinate with engineering/R&D for complex issues.
* **Operational Rigor**
* + Plan daily site activities, track milestones, and report progress; manage materials, tools, and test equipment availability.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong commissioning & troubleshooting skills in **SCADA/SAS** environments.
* Practical knowledge of **IEC 61850 engineering** (SCL/ICD/CID/SCD), MMS/GOOSE/SV concepts.
* Hands-on with **PSO, EPAS, Zenon** (or equivalent SCADA platforms).
* Proficiency with **Modbus RTU/TCP, Profibus, Ethernet/IP** and industrial networking.
* Experience with **numerical relays** (Schneider, ABB, Siemens, GE).
* Working knowledge of **PLC (M580/M340)** and **RTU (Saitel/T500)** programming.
* Readiness for **Pan-India travel** and on-call.
* Strong communication, documentation, and customer handling skills.
* Safety-first mindset; adherence to LOTO and site HSE requirements.

(External) English Qualifications:

**Qualifications**

* **B.E./B.Tech** in **Electrical/Electronics/Telecommunication** (Mandatory).
* **2-4 years** of relevant experience in **substation automation/SCADA commissioning**.

**Good to Have (Preferred):**

* Certifications: **IEC 61850 Engineer**, Schneider **EcoStruxure**/EPAS/PSO, COPA-DATA **Zenon**, networking (CCNA/Industrial Ethernet).
* Exposure to utility specifications (EIL/PGCIL/State DISCOMs), cybersecurity basics, NTP/PTP time sync.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* On-time **SAT completion** and project handover.
* **First-time-right** commissioning & defect closure cycle time.
* Compliance to **HSE** and quality standards.
* **Customer satisfaction** (CSAT/NPS) and escalation avoidance.
* Documentation accuracy and **as-built completeness**.

**Travel & Work Conditions**

* Extensive **Pan-India travel** (70–90% as per project needs).
* Work at substations/industrial sites with adherence to company and client HSE norms.
* weekend work as per commissioning windows.

title: Onboarding Engineer
description:
**Designation:** Onboarding Engineer

  

**Experience:** 5+ Years

**Work Location:** Mumbai

**About Techdefence:**

Techdefence is a leading cybersecurity solutions provider specializing in offensive and defensive security, AI-powered threat intelligence, and enterprise security frameworks. Our comprehensive services and product portfolio cater to global enterprises, government agencies, and critical infrastructure, ensuring proactive protection against cyber threats.

With a strong R&D focus, Techdefence delivers cutting-edge security solutions in the areas of cloud security, network security, application security, penetration testing, SOC solutions, and managed security services. Our expertise in cyber resilience, risk management, and compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR, PCI-DSS, etc.) positions us as a trusted partner for organizations worldwide.

**Job Description:**

  

* Onboard security and IT log sources into SIEM platforms.
* Configure log collection using Syslog, APIs, agents, and cloud integrations.
* Perform log parsing, normalization, field mapping, and data quality validation.
* Develop custom parsers and troubleshoot log ingestion issues.
* Integrate logs from firewalls, EDR/XDR, IAM, AWS, Azure, and other infrastructure sources.
* Collaborate with SOC and detection engineering teams.

**Required Skills:**

  

* Hands-on experience with at least one SIEM platform.
* Knowledge of Syslog, REST APIs, JSON, XML, regex, and log parsing.
* Working knowledge of Python/Shell scripting and Linux/Windows logging.
* Understanding of network protocols, SOC operations, and MITRE ATT&CK.

The Head Technical Operations - South Asia is a strategic leadership role responsible for driving the overall technical, application, service excellence, and customer support agenda across South Asia. * Manage and resolve critical customer escalations in a timely and effective manner.
* Establish escalation governance and root cause analysis processes.
* Partner with global technical and engineering teams to address recurring technical issues.

* Ensure consistent execution and successful conversion of trials into commercial opportunities.
* Partner with commercial teams to accelerate customer adoption.

**Vendor & Special Applications Management**

* Develop strategic partnerships to expand Videojet's solution offerings.
* Ensure vendor performance, compliance, and quality standards are maintained.
* Drive execution excellence for Special Application Solutions (SAS).

**Safety Leadership**

* Drive compliance with environmental, health, and safety standards.
* Ensure field operations adhere to company safety requirements and industry regulations.
* Lead safety awareness, training, risk assessment, and incident prevention programs.

title: Infrastructure and Platform Engineer
description:
Job Code: 15049

Country: IN

City: Mumbai

Skill Category: IT\Technology

Description:

**Overview:**
  
  
Nomura is a global financial services group with an integrated network spanning approximately 30 countries and regions. By connecting markets East & West, Nomura services the needs of individuals, institutions, corporates and governments through its three business divisions: Wealth Management, Investment Management, and Wholesale (Global Markets and Investment Banking). Founded in 1925, the firm is built on a tradition of disciplined entrepreneurship, serving clients with creative solutions and considered thought leadership. For further information about Nomura, visit www.nomura.com
  
  
Nomura Services India, (Powai) supports Nomura’s businesses around the world. Powai’ s world class capabilities in trading support, research, information technology, financial control, operations, risk management and legal support have played a key role in facilitating Nomura’s global operations and are an integral part of Nomura’s global expansion plans. The Powai operation is a critical part of the platform to support the growth of Nomura’s global business.

Nomura is looking for **Backup & Storage Engineering team member** who will be part of the Nomura’s Backup & Storage systems. The said candidate will be responsible for design, engineering, & automation of Nomura Backup platform on-premises & on the Public Cloud

The role is based out of Mumbai, India and will be part of the Nomura Service India Pvt Ltd.

With an objective to ensure a highly automated, scalable & user-friendly Backup platform, the candidate will work on various projects & deliveries in the Backup & Storage work stream

  

**Required Experience & Skills**

* **Automation Orchestration:** Strong proficiency with Ansible Core and Ansible Tower (AWX), including job templates, workflows, and dynamic inventories.
* **Programming Languages:** Advanced Python scripting skills, specifically using libraries for API consumption (requests), data manipulation (pandas), and testing.
* **Version Control:** Hand-on experience with Git and CI/CD pipeline (Gitlab/Jenkins) to integrate automation workflows and streamline deployment.
* **Cloud:** Experience od backup and storage workloads on public cloud like AWS.
* **Data & Reporting:** Experience in reporting/dashboard tools like Power BI/Graffana and manipulating JSON, XML, and CSV data formats to generate executive-ready performance metrics (added advantage).
* **Backup Architecture:** Hands-on administration and knowledge of NetBackup (added advantage).
* Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure and deployment issues.
* Documenting system designs & process workflows
* Clear & precise communication
  

**Key Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Develop, test, and deploy Ansible playbooks and roles to automate daily NetBackup operations.
* Create reusable, secure Ansible roles/modules for backup agent deployment, policy management, and client updates.
* Manage, schedule, and orchestrate complex infrastructure workflows using Ansible Tower.
* Write clean, maintainable Python scripts to interact with NetBackup APIs (RESTful APIs).
* Build custom integrations between Ansible Tower, NetBackup/Public Cloud, and ServiceNOW ticketing/monitoring systems.
* Design and automate the generation of daily, weekly, and monthly backup reports and dashboards.
* Manage all infrastructure code and automation scripts using Git and maintain repositories within GitLab, ensuring version control standards and collaboration best practices are followed.
* Work closely with development and operations teams to define infrastructure standards, troubleshoot complex issues efficiently, and ensure seamless software releases.
* Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for all automated systems and processes and drive the adoption of DevOps and SRE best practices.
  

**Nomura Leadership Behaviours**

  

* **Explore Insights & Vision:** Identify the underlying causes of problems faced by you or your team and define a clear vision and direction for the future.
* **Making Strategic Decisions**: Evaluate all the options for resolving the problems and effectively prioritize actions or recommendations.
* **Inspire Entrepreneurship in People**: Inspire team members through effective communication of ideas and motivate them to actively enhance productivity.
* **Elevate Organizational Capability**: Engage proactively in professional development and enhance team productivity through the promotion of knowledge sharing.
* **Inclusion****:** Respect DEI, foster a culture of inclusion and psychological safety in the workplace and cultivate a "Risk Culture" (Challenge, Escalate and Respect).

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**

description:

We strive to foster a caring, high-performance growth culture that will deliver consistent, sustainable profitable growth and accelerate our performance – a culture where accountability is clear and aligned, and where we reward business outcomes and impact. In 2025, Sealed Air generated $5.4 billion in sales and has approximately 16,100 employees who serve customers in 119 countries/territories. To learn more, visit www.sealedair.com.

**Senior Platform Engineer**
----------------------------

Sealed Air is seeking a highly skilled and self-motivated Senior Cloud Platform Migration Engineer to assume ownership of critical cloud infrastructure supporting customer-facing digital services and connected manufacturing capabilities.

The successful candidate will stabilize, operate, document, and modernize an existing AWS-based platform ecosystem while helping drive the long-term strategic transition to Microsoft Azure. The role requires practical experience with AWS, Cloud Foundry, GitLab, automation, infrastructure-as-code, Linux, security, and cloud platform operations.

This is not primarily an application development role. The candidate must understand enough about application hosting patterns to support infrastructure decisions, troubleshoot platform-level issues, and partner effectively with application teams, but application code ownership and long-term application modernization.

**What are we looking for in you?**
-----------------------------------

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Cloud Platform Ownership**
----------------------------

* Own the operational health, reliability, security, and lifecycle management of assigned cloud-hosted infrastructure platforms.
* Administer current-state AWS platform components including IAM, networking, compute, storage, platform services, encryption, and security controls.
* Support and maintain Cloud Foundry and BOSH platform infrastructure, including stemcells, releases, manifests, routing dependencies, certificates, and operational procedures.
* Manage platform patching, operating system lifecycle activities, certificate renewals, vulnerability remediation, and related production maintenance activities.
* Create and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, technical diagrams, and support procedures for inherited and future-state environments.

**Azure Migration and Modernization**
-------------------------------------

* Help lead infrastructure planning and execution for migration from AWS-hosted platform services to Azure-based target-state architecture.
* Assess current AWS, Cloud Foundry, GitLab, Linux, networking, IAM, and platform service dependencies to define migration approach, risks, sequencing, and operational impacts.
* Design repeatable Azure infrastructure patterns aligned to enterprise standards, including identity, network, security, monitoring, backup, and operational support models.
* Partner with Jayaram's application team to ensure application workloads are migrated or modernized with a clear separation between application ownership and infrastructure platform ownership.
* Develop migration automation and validation patterns to reduce risk and improve repeatability across future transitions.

* 7+ years of cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps, automation, or related infrastructure operations experience.
* Strong hands-on AWS experience, including operational support of production cloud infrastructure.

* Hands-on scripting and automation experience with Python and Shell/Bash.
* Experience with GitLab, CI/CD pipelines, Linux administration, infrastructure automation, and cloud security practices.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform and/or CloudFormation.
* Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, documentation, and operational problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to operate independently in a partially documented inherited environment and convert ambiguity into structured technical action plans.
* Cloud Foundry administration experience, especially with self-managed or legacy platform environments.
* BOSH administration experience, including directors, stemcells, releases, manifests, and platform lifecycle management.
* Experience migrating workloads or platform services between public cloud providers, especially AWS to Azure.
* Experience with Azure landing zones, Azure networking, Azure identity, Azure Monitor, Azure Policy, and Azure-native platform services.
* Experience administering self-hosted GitLab, including upgrades, runners, access controls, storage, backups, and migration to SaaS or alternate DevOps platforms.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes, containers, platform-as-a-service models, and modern application hosting patterns.
* Experience supporting industrial IoT, connected device, or manufacturing-adjacent cloud platforms.

**Nomura Overview:**

  

Nomura is a financial services group with an integrated global network. By connecting markets East & West, Nomura services the needs of individuals, institutions, corporates and governments through its four business divisions: Wealth Management, Investment Management, Wholesale (Global Markets and Investment Banking), and Banking. Nomura Services, India supports the group’s global businesses. With world-class capabilities in trading support, research, information technology, financial control, operations, risk management and legal support, the firm plays a key role in facilitating the group’s global operations across four international regions.

  

At Nomura, creating an inclusive workplace is a priority. Our approach to inclusion encompasses a variety of initiatives, including sensitization campaigns, implementing conducive policies & programs, providing infrastructure support and engaging in community events. Over time, we have made meaningful progress in these areas, and this commitment has been well-recognized across the industry. We are proud recipients of the prestigious Top 10 Employers award by the India Workplace Equality Index (IWEI), IWEI Gold Employer of Choice awards, India CSR Leadership Award 2024 for Holistic Village Development Program and the YUVA Unstoppable Changemaker Awards.

  

**Divisional Overview:**

Risk Management Division in Powai has the following functions – Credit risk, Market risk, Quant risk, Model Validation, Operational risk and Market Risk Infrastructure.

  

**Business Overview:**

Market Risk Management works to identify, monitor and control the firm’s exposure to risk, analyze stress test results, and provide analysis on new products and businesses. Powai Market Risk managers liaise with the risk managers in the trading centres on a daily basis to help manage their market exposure, set & review risk strategies. Major activities involve daily analysis and interpretation of the results of risk sensitivities; validation of Value At Risk (VaR), RWA, Economic Capital numbers and sign-off on the relevant Risk systems, working on global projects for enhancement of Market Risk & preparation of risk reports for traders and senior business management. Risk managers are also expected to automate/re-engineer the risk reporting process and provide ad-hoc risk views and drill down analysis of less transparent risks and issues of importance to senior Risk Management/Trading Heads

  

**What We Offer:**

  

* We support employee wellbeing by ensuring a sense of purpose and belonging.
* We offer a comprehensive range of wellbeing services which allows employees to get access to the assistance they need at any point in their wellbeing journey.
* Our bespoke benefits support employees and their family’s holistic wellbeing and are inclusive of diverse identities and family structures.
  

**Position Specifications:**

  

**Corporate Title**

**Vice President**

  

**Functional Title**

**Vice President**

  

**Experience**

**7 to 10 Years**

  

**Qualification**

**MBA from a reputed institute or Masters with engineering/math/science/CA background**

  

**Requisition No.**

**15205**

* As a dedicated risk manager for the Rates Structured and Exotics business areas, the candidate will be responsible for managing the following
  + Partnering with the risk managers in the trading centers as senior escalation point, setting & challenging risk strategies
  + Daily analysis and interpretation of risk sensitivities and stress tests, including vega surface, skew and correlation risks
  + Ownership of risk reports for traders and senior business management
  + Ownership of the limit framework, including limit levels and resolution of limit excesses
  + Preparation of reports and escalation to senior management
  + Ad-hoc risk views and drill down analysis of less transparent risks, including model reliance and unhedgeable risks
  + Review and challenge of new and bespoke structured trades with Quants and Risk Methodology
  + Supervision of junior risk managers and global collaboration across London, New York and Tokyo
  + Re-engineering of the risk reporting process including interactions with Risk and front Office technology personnel to drive improvements
* The Risk Manager will need to understand the traded products in these asset classes, factors influencing markets and their implications for risk management decisions. In particular, we are looking for candidates with knowledge of Rates derivatives, with depth in exotic and structured payoffs, and exposure to flow and structured fixed income desks

Candidate is expected to understand what drives the risk profiles of Fixed Income and structured instruments in different market conditions (exposure profiles, higher-order sensitivities and model dependency) and implications of how the markets are evolving, with the credibility to challenge traders, quants and senior management

**Role & Responsibilities:**

  

**Mind Set:**

  

**Mandatory**

**Desired**

  

**Domain**

* Good knowledge of Financial Products (especially derivatives including exotic and structured payoffs), Financial Markets, Economics
* Understanding of option greeks and higher-order sensitivities (vega surface, skew, convexity, cross-gamma, correlation)
* Working knowledge of derivatives pricing models, calibration and their limitations
* Background in a numerical discipline: engineering; math; science; etc.
* Understanding of risk sensitivities and VaR/Economic Capital
* Strong analytical, quantitative and technical abilities
* Ability to challenge and influence traders and senior stakeholders, and hold a position under pressure
* Strong communication skills (oral and written)

* Masters (MBA preferred) from a tier-1 institution
* Certification in CFA/FRM

  

**Technical**

* Python for Finance
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel

* BI Tools

At Rush Networks LLP, we believe that every employee should have an opportunity to learn, perform and grow. We are a UPS AMC and service provider with a PAN-India service support network, helping customers maintain reliable and uninterrupted power solutions.

We are looking for a proactive, organised and enthusiastic **Service Coordinator** who wants to build a long-term career in service operations and customer management.

This is more than a coordination role — it is an opportunity to understand technical service operations, work closely with customers and engineers, develop problem-solving skills, and progress towards higher responsibilities based on performance.

* Practical exposure to real-world service operations and customer management.
* Opportunities to learn technical service processes and develop professional skills.
* Increasing responsibility based on performance and capability.
* A collaborative working environment where initiative and ownership matter.
* A long-term career path for candidates who demonstrate commitment and a willingness to learn.

description:

Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**L3 Support Engineer**
=======================

**Location:** Mumbai
  
**Experience:** 2+ Years

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a place where you'll be empowered to shape your career, supported by a collaborative global community, and inspired to reimagine what's possible. Join us in helping leading organizations unlock the value of technology and drive scalable, sustainable growth.

**Your Role**
-------------

As an L3 Support Engineer, you will provide advanced technical support for enterprise retail and POS environments. You will be responsible for troubleshooting complex incidents, supporting critical business applications, and ensuring seamless operations across Windows, networking, cloud, and infrastructure platforms. You will work closely with L1 and L2 support teams while providing escalations and resolutions for high-priority issues.

**In this role, you will:**
---------------------------

* Provide L3 technical support for Windows-based systems and enterprise applications.
* Troubleshoot and resolve incidents related to networking, operating systems, peripherals, and retail POS devices.
* Investigate issues involving IP Addressing, DNS, DHCP, Domain Controllers, Network Switches, and connectivity.
* Support retail store technologies including POS terminals, payment card readers, handheld POS devices, scanners, printers, and other peripherals.
* Manage incident resolution for escalated tickets from Service Desk teams following established SOPs.
* Analyze logs using Splunk and troubleshoot platform and application issues.
* Perform root cause analysis and coordinate with Tier 3 teams for complex incidents.
* Monitor and support distributed systems, microservices, and cloud-based applications.
* Troubleshoot Kubernetes workloads, logs, and containerized environments.
* Support Linux and Windows server environments.
* Utilize PowerShell and Python scripts for automation, diagnostics, and operational efficiency.
* Work in a 24x7 support environment, ensuring service availability and adherence to SLAs.

**Your Profile**

title: System Engineer- Defence/Maritime Projects
description:
**Position:** Senior System Engineer / Package Lead – Marine & Defense  

**Experience:** 4 to 10 Years

  
  

**Qualification:** B.Tech / B.E. in Electrical Engineering or Electronics Engineering (or equivalent)

  
  

**Location:** Mumbai

  
  

**Job Type:** Full-time

  
  

### **Position Overview**

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven **Senior System Engineer** to lead and execute electrical, electronic, and embedded control system work packages for high-impact shipbuilding and defense projects.

  
  

In this role, you will be responsible for end-to-end system design, system and sensor integration, PLC logic programming, and power distribution. You will oversee the complete project lifecycle from planning and design management to hands-on installation, integration, testing, and commissioning, ensuring safe, timely, and quality execution.

  
  

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Technical Leadership & Package Management:**

    
    
  + Lead the system design, development, and delivery of electrical, electronics, and embedded control system work packages for marine and defense applications.
  + Plan, coordinate, and supervise technical work packages to maintain project schedules, safety standards, and quality specifications.
* **System & Sensor Integration:**

    
    
  + Perform hands-on system integration for complex marine/defense hardware and software architectures.
  + Execute seamless sensor integration (e.g., radar, sonar, navigation sensors, environmental sensors) with control and monitoring systems.
  + Implement and manage distributed computing architectures for real-time control and monitoring applications.
* **Power Electronics & Distribution:**

    
    
  + Oversee power electronics and power distribution systems design and integration for onboard marine and defense platforms.
  + Ensure proper load management, grounding, shielding, and power supply isolation across embedded and power networks.
* **PLC Logic & Control System Engineering:**

    
    
  + Program, configure, and troubleshoot Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs) for automation, control systems, and machinery instrumentation.
  + Design logic routines, safety interlocks, and automated control loops.
* **Installation, Testing & Commissioning:**

    
    
  + Supervise and conduct site/vessel installation, system integration, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), and final commissioning of embedded control systems and electrical machinery.
  + Analyze trial data, resolve system integration anomalies, and ensure compliance with defense and marine standards.

### **Key Skills & Qualifications**

* **Education:** B.Tech / B.E. in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline.
* **Experience:** 4 to 10 years of hands-on engineering experience in **shipbuilding, defense, marine, or embedded systems** projects.
* **Technical Expertise:**

    
    
  + Hands-on experience with **System & Sensor Integration**.
  + Proficiency in **Distributed Computing Systems** and real-time data communication protocols (CAN, Ethernet, Modbus, NMEA, RS-485/232).
  + In-depth knowledge of **Power Electronics** and low/medium voltage **Power Distribution**.
  + Hands-on experience in **PLC Logic Programming**, HMI design, and industrial automation tools.
  + Strong expertise in installation, integration, testing, and commissioning of electrical, electronic, and embedded control hardware.
* **Soft Skills:** Strong leadership, cross-functional coordination, problem-solving, and quality-driven execution.

title: Principal Production Services
description:

Country: IN

City: Mumbai

Skill Category: IT\Technology

Description:

**Nomura Overview:**

Nomura is a financial services group with an integrated global network. By connecting markets East & West, Nomura services the needs of individuals, institutions, corporates and governments through its four business divisions: Wealth Management, Investment Management, Wholesale (Global Markets and Investment Banking), and Banking. For further information about Nomura, visit www.nomura.com.

Nomura Services, India supports the group’s global businesses. With world-class capabilities in trading support, research, information technology, financial control, operations, risk management and legal support, the firm plays a key role in facilitating the group’s global operations across four international regions.

  

At Nomura, creating an inclusive workplace is a priority. Our approach to inclusion encompasses a variety of initiatives, including sensitization campaigns, implementing conducive policies & programs, providing infrastructure support and engaging in community events. Over time, we have made meaningful progress in these areas, and this commitment has been well-recognized across the industry. We are proud recipients of the prestigious Top 10 Employers award by the India Workplace Equality Index (IWEI), IWEI Gold Employer of Choice awards, India CSR Leadership Award 2024 for Holistic Village Development Program and the YUVA Unstoppable Changemaker Awards.

  

**Divisional Overview:**

Powai Information security division is an integral part of Nomura where mostly support functions are delivered out of this entity. We mainly support Nomura wholesale business.

Senior management takes a hands-on approach within the department, and is keen to reward hard work, enthusiasm and success. Nomura presents a unique opportunity to learn and gain experience of a broad range of products and business lines within a supportive setting and surrounded by skilled professionals.

  

**Business Overview:**

We are seeking a skilled Automation Engineer to join our Information Security team within the Automation & AI function. This role combines Python development expertise with modern AI application development to drive intelligent automation initiatives across our security operations. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience building web applications, APIs, and AI-powered solutions, and security orchestration playbooks while maintaining a solid understanding of cybersecurity principles. You will work at the intersection of security, automation, and AI to transform how our organization approaches information security challenges.

  

**What We Offer:**

* We support employee wellbeing by ensuring a sense of purpose and belonging.
* We offer a comprehensive range of wellbeing services which allows employees to get access to the assistance they need at any point in their wellbeing journey.
* Our bespoke benefits support employees and their family’s holistic wellbeing and are inclusive of diverse identities and family structures.

**Key objectives critical to success**

We are looking for a talented and experienced professional to join our team as Security Engineer with specific focus on network security and boundary controls. In this role, you will part of a team leading the engineering, development, and implementation of a robust and scalable information security solutions to protect Nomura’s critical assets. This role is technical and hands-on as the security architecture and engineering strategy and roadmap are being developed and requires deep understanding of network security and best practices in cybersecurity. It requires the development and implementation of processes, policies, standards, and solutions in collaboration with the Global Head of information security engineering and key stakeholders You will play a key role in ensuring the resilience and effectiveness of network security solutions.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Network Security Architecture & Strategy: Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the organization's network security needs across on-premise and cloud environments. Design and implement comprehensive security architectures that protect network infrastructure from unauthorized access, data loss, and emerging security threats while aligning with business objectives and the Security Risks and Controls Framework.

* Web Application & DDoS Protection **Engineering**: Lead the design, deployment, and management of web application firewall solutions including advanced bot protection, API security controls, and distributed denial-of-service mitigation. Develop automation frameworks leveraging RESTful APIs integrated with DevOps/CI-CD pipelines to enable policy-as-code deployment, rule management, and configuration-as-code practices for scalable security operations.
* **Network Detection & Response Operations**: Deploy and manage network detection and response (NDR) platforms for real-time visibility into east-west and north-south traffic patterns. Analyze network telemetry, detect anomalous behavior, investigate security incidents, and develop detection use cases to identify threats including lateral movement, data exfiltration, and command-and-control communications.
* **Secure Web Gateway & Cloud Proxy Management**: Operate and optimize secure web gateway and cloud proxy solutions to enforce internet access policies, URL filtering, SSL/TLS inspection, and data loss prevention controls. Manage policy frameworks for user and application traffic, integrate with identity providers, and ensure secure access for remote and on-premise users.
* **Zero-Trust Micro-Segmentation Implementation**: Design and deploy micro-segmentation technologies to enforce zero-trust network access controls and application dependency mapping. Develop segmentation policies based on application workflows, implement least-privilege network access, and reduce lateral movement attack surface across data center and cloud workloads.
* **Technology Evaluation & Deployment**: Evaluate and deploy network security technologies and tools to enhance security posture. Lead proof-of-concept initiatives, conduct market research, and collaborate with cross-functional teams including architecture, infrastructure, and application development to assess control alignments, integration requirements, and business fit before making investment recommendations.
* **Security Policy & Standards Governance**: Develop and enforce security policies, standards, and technical guidelines in alignment with regulatory requirements (PCI-DSS, SOC2, regional data protection regulations) and network security best practices. Ensure policy frameworks address emerging threats and remain practical for operational implementation across all network security technologies.
* **Operational Maturity & Service Excellence**: Develop operational models and drive maturity elevation across all network security technologies in alignment with industry frameworks (ITIL, NIST, ISO). Establish KPIs, operational metrics, and continuous improvement programs to achieve target maturity levels for detection, response, prevention, and recovery capabilities with documented operational runbooks and playbooks.
* **ITSM Compliance & Audit Readiness**: Ensure IT Service Management best practices are followed across all network security operations. Build and maintain audit-ready documentation including standard operating procedures, runbooks, change management protocols, incident response playbooks, and compliance evidence repositories that satisfy internal audit and regulatory examination requirements.
* **Vendor Management & SLA Governance**: Manage vendor relationships and contract governance for network security platforms. Define clear deliverables, establish achievable SLAs/OLAs with measurable success criteria, conduct quarterly business reviews, and maintain ongoing governance frameworks to ensure vendor accountability, performance optimization, and value realization.
* **Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration**: Manage and mentor the network security operations team across multiple geographies to support Follow-the-Sun operational models and 24/7 service delivery. Collaborate with Security Operations Center (SOC), application service owners, infrastructure teams, cloud platform teams, and business units to ensure seamless integration of network security controls, facilitate incident response coordination, and maintain effective communication channels for operational transparency.
* **Threat Intelligence & Continuous Innovation**: Stay current on emerging technologies, trends, and threats in network security including web application protection, API security, DDoS mitigation, network detection, zero-trust architectures, and secure access service edge (SASE) models. Translate threat intelligence into actionable security improvements, rule updates, detection signatures, and proactive defense measures to maintain a robust and adaptive security posture
  

**Skills, experience, qualifications and knowledge required**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field; Master's degree preferred.
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) or Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) certification is required.
* 5-8 of years of experience in information security, with a focus on network security
* Proven experience in designing and implementing network security solutions in an enterprise environment (WAF, DDoS, IDS/IPS, Proxy)
* Strong knowledge of security technologies on security network protocols, and frameworks, such as ISO 27001, NIST, and OWASP.
* Familiar with network segmentation strategies to limit the spread of security incidents and improve the overall security posture of our network.
* Familiar with implementing network security controls for cloud
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with diverse teams and stakeholders.
  

**Personal Characteristics:**

* Strong communication skills, ability to work comfortably with different regions
* Good team player, ability to work on a local, regional and global basis and as part of joint cross location initiative.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Ability to work independently and as strong team player in global team
* Ability to run with multiple tasks concurrently and manage expectations appropriately.

* Exceptional stakeholder management skills. Proven ability to influence global engineering leaders and corporate executives to prioritize regional initiatives without having direct reporting authority over them.

title: Global Command Center Operations Senior Manager
description:
**About NCR Atleos**


NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self\-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.

**POSITION SUMMARY**
====================


The Global Command Center Operations Manager is responsible for leading the 24x7 Global Command Center responsible for monitoring, event correlation, incident response, escalation coordination, operational communications, and service reliability across critical infrastructure, applications, networks, job scheduling, and telephony services. This role provides operational leadership for geographically distributed teams and ensures that Command Center functions consistently meet availability, resiliency, compliance, and service management expectations.


The successful candidate will be a hands\-on, metrics\-driven operations leader with strong ITIL/ITSM discipline, deep infrastructure operations awareness, and the ability to translate technical events into clear executive\-level business impact. This leader will drive process maturity, automation, alert quality, stakeholder alignment, and continuous improvement across global operations while maintaining a high\-accountability and service\-focused team culture.

**ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
=============================

**Operational Leadership and Service Reliability**
--------------------------------------------------

* Lead day\-to\-day and shift\-based 24x7 Global Command Center operations across monitoring, triage, escalation, incident communications, and operational coordination.
* Oversee functional coverage for server operations monitoring, network operations monitoring, application operations monitoring, lab operations monitoring, Helix/Control\-M job scheduling, Windows and Linux L2 support, and Genesys/IP telephony operations.
* Ensure adherence to SLAs, OLAs, uptime expectations, alert response targets, escalation procedures, and operational performance metrics.
* Drive proactive monitoring, event correlation, alert tuning, runbook quality, and automation to reduce noise, improve response times, and minimize manual intervention.
* Maintain operational readiness for high\-severity events, business\-impacting incidents, planned maintenance windows, and critical change activity.

**Incident, Problem, and Change Management**
--------------------------------------------

* Lead Command Center participation in major incidents by coordinating bridge engagement, ensuring role clarity, maintaining focus on service restoration, and escalating to appropriate technical and leadership teams.
* Partner with Major Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, infrastructure, application, security, and vendor teams to support fast restoration and durable corrective actions.
* Review incident trends, recurring alerts, failed jobs, chronic infrastructure events, and escalation patterns to identify improvement opportunities.
* Support post\-incident reviews, root cause analysis, known error documentation, corrective/preventive action tracking, and lessons\-learned adoption.
* Ensure Command Center teams follow approved change, incident, problem, access, and communication processes.

**Governance, Compliance, and Audit Readiness**
-----------------------------------------------

* Create, maintain, and enforce SOPs, technical runbooks, escalation matrices, knowledge articles, operational checklists, and process documentation.
* Ensure operational evidence is complete, accurate, timely, and defensible for internal reviews, SOX audits, control testing, and regulatory inquiries.
* Partner with security, risk, compliance, and technology owners to ensure adherence to enterprise standards, access protocols, and data protection expectations.
* Establish governance routines to review operational metrics, control gaps, aged actions, process exceptions, and continuous improvement progress.

**Team Leadership and Talent Development**
------------------------------------------

* Lead, coach, and develop a globally distributed team of team leads, engineers, analysts, and operations specialists across multiple shifts and domains.
* Own staffing plans, shift coverage, onboarding, training, performance expectations, development plans, succession planning, and quality accountability.
* Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, operational discipline, customer focus, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with site leadership to monitor team engagement, morale, readiness, skill gaps, escalation behaviors, and adherence to operational standards.

**Metrics, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement**
--------------------------------------------------

* Define, monitor, and report operational KPIs including availability, SLA adherence, alert volume, alert aging, MTTA/MTTR, escalation effectiveness, incident recurrence, job failure trends, change\-related incidents, and runbook compliance.
* Prepare concise executive\-level updates on operational health, incident trends, risk areas, improvement plans, staffing readiness, and service reliability.
* Use data to identify systemic issues, automation opportunities, process bottlenecks, and training needs.
* Partner with tool owners and engineering teams to improve dashboards, observability, event correlation, workflow automation, and operational intelligence.

**Vendor and Stakeholder Management**
-------------------------------------

* Manage vendor engagement related to operations tools, monitoring platforms, job scheduling, infrastructure services, telecom platforms, and support escalations.
* Hold vendors and internal service teams accountable for service delivery, timely escalation, issue ownership, and contractual/service commitments.
* Serve as an operational bridge between senior leadership, infrastructure teams, application teams, security, service management, vendors, and site leadership.
* Support budget planning, resource planning, capacity needs, tool rationalization, and operational investment recommendations.

**SKILL REQUIREMENTS/PREFERENCES**
==================================

**Required Skills and Experience**
----------------------------------

* 12\+ years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure operations, technology operations, command center, NOC/SOC/AOC, service management, or related enterprise technology functions.
* 8\+ years of people leadership experience, including leading managers, team leads, engineers, analysts, or shift\-based operational teams in a 24x7 environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing global or multi\-site operations with cross\-functional responsibility for service reliability, monitoring, incident response, escalation, and executive communication.
* Strong working knowledge of ITIL/ITSM practices, including incident, major incident, problem, change, request, knowledge, and service level management.
* Experience with enterprise monitoring, observability, alerting, ITSM, and job scheduling platforms such as ServiceNow, Helix, Control\-M, SolarWinds, Grafana, Splunk, Nagios, Zabbix, Datadog, AppDynamics, or equivalent tools.
* Working knowledge of Windows and Linux server operations, virtualization, cloud infrastructure, network fundamentals, firewalls, VPNs, SD\-WAN, DNS/DHCP, telephony/VoIP, and application operations monitoring.
* Experience creating operational dashboards, performance reporting, service health reviews, incident trend analysis, and continuous improvement plans.
* Experience supporting audit, compliance, access control, SOX, control evidence, policy adherence, and operational governance processes.
* Strong vendor management, escalation management, service accountability, and stakeholder communication capabilities.

**Preferred Technical Skills**
------------------------------

* Experience with hybrid cloud environments including Azure, Oracle Cloud, AWS, VMware vSphere, or similar enterprise platforms.
* Experience improving event management through alert rationalization, event correlation, automation, AIOps, or runbook orchestration.
* Familiarity with resiliency practices including disaster recovery, business continuity, capacity planning, lifecycle management, backup/recovery, high availability, and operational risk reduction.
* Familiarity with scripting or automation concepts using PowerShell, Python, Bash, API integrations, workflow automation, or infrastructure\-as\-code concepts.
* Experience leading transformation efforts that modernize command center operations, reduce toil, improve service health visibility, or improve incident response maturity.

**SOME OF THE SOFT SKILLS / ABILITIES REQUIRED FOR YOU TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE INCLUDE**
==============================================================================================

* Calm, composed leadership during high\-pressure, business\-impacting incidents.
* Clear, concise, and audience\-appropriate communication for executives, technical teams, vendors, and business stakeholders.
* Ability to command and control incident bridges while maintaining accountability, urgency, and respectful collaboration.
* Strong judgment, prioritization, and decision\-making when managing competing business, technical, and operational demands.
* Ability to translate technical issues into business impact, risk, service health, and actionable leadership updates.
* Coaching mindset with the ability to build trust, develop team leads, provide feedback, and reinforce standard work.
* High ownership and follow\-through across open actions, recurring issues, audit items, staffing needs, and operational risks.
* Process discipline with the ability to standardize work, reduce ambiguity, document expectations, and drive consistent execution.
* Strong analytical capability with a focus on metrics, trend analysis, root cause thinking, and measurable improvement.
* Ability to influence across teams without direct authority and create alignment across geographically distributed stakeholders.
* Comfort operating in a fast\-paced, global, shift\-based environment where priorities may change quickly.

**ADDITIONAL PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
=======================================

* ITIL 4 Foundation, ITIL Managing Professional, PMP, Lean Six Sigma, CISSP, CISM, Microsoft Azure, AWS, Linux, Cisco, VMware, ServiceNow, or equivalent certifications.
* Experience leading a global command center, NOC, SOC, AOC, infrastructure operations center, managed services operations, or enterprise service reliability function.
* Experience building or maturing operating models, RACI matrices, escalation frameworks, QA programs, knowledge management practices, or operational control points.
* Experience with financial services, payments, ATM, retail banking, regulated infrastructure, or other high\-availability customer\-impacting technology environments.
* Experience supporting business continuity, disaster recovery exercises, command center readiness testing, crisis management, or operational resilience programs.
* Experience managing cross\-cultural teams, offshore/onshore delivery models, and vendor\-supported services.

**EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS**
==========================

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Technology, or a related discipline required, or equivalent combination of education and progressive enterprise IT operations experience.
* Master’s degree in Information Systems, Technology Management, Business Administration, or related discipline preferred.
* Relevant professional certifications may be considered in combination with demonstrated leadership and enterprise technology operations experience.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT AND EXPECTATIONS**
=====================================

* Full\-time role based in Mumbai, India with expectation to work from the office five days per week unless otherwise approved by leadership.
* Must be able to support a 24x7 global operations model, including rotational schedules, after\-hours escalations, planned maintenance windows, and major incident response as business needs require.
* Must be comfortable working with global stakeholders across multiple time zones and supporting business\-critical technology services.


Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job.

**EEO Statement**  

NCR Atleos is an equal\-opportunity employer. It is NCR Atleos policy to hire, train, promote, and pay associates based on their job\-related qualifications, ability, and performance, without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, marital status, age, mental or physical disability, genetic information, medical condition, military or veteran status, or any other factor protected by law.

Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, NCR Atleos employees, or any NCR Atleos facility. AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is growing rapidly, and we are looking for Data Center Technician to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team.  

Data Center Operations designs, installs and maintains the world’s largest Computing Infrastructure. Our scope of work includes systems, repairing, dealing with issues, handling and tracking parts and assisting in Data Center maintenance. Amazon Data Centers are large\-scale high\-density centers where you will help change the face of Technology in the region.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As Data Centre Operations Engineer, you will be the primary point of contact for internal customers. There is never a dull moment as each day presents itself with different challenges. Some of the key responsibilities you will undertake are:  

  

* You will troubleshoot technical issues on advanced hardware, ranging from servers, storage and networking devices on a 24/7 basis.
* You will maintain a high level of system reliability and availability.
* You will participate in projects to enhance operational efficiencies with opportunities to share experiences and knowledge with our global network of technical experts.
* You will share knowledge and help train less technical staff on the best practices related to all service owner issues
* You will contribute towards building a great team by getting involved in the Amazon hiring process/candidate interviews

  

A day in the life  

As a successful Data Center Operations engineer, your day\-to\-day work will include:  

* Installation and configurations on Data center Servers and Network systems
* Installation, troubleshooting and replacement of internal and external hardware parts of Servers and Network devices
* Work within a ticket\-based environment and work on systematic problem resolution
* Work on rotational shift\-based schedule to maintain high system reliability
* Collaborate with internal teams and share ideas and contribute in innovative projects to improve DC work environment and overall efficiencies.

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences
  

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  

Inclusive Team Culture
  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship and Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure

description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.



You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.


### **Job Summary**



We are looking for a detail\-oriented, technically skilled Rack Lifecycle Tech to join our Rack Lifecycle Team within AWS Infrastructure Operations. In this individual contributor role, you will be a hands\-on executor responsible for the physical installation, cabling, handoff, and decommissioning of racks across your assigned data center site. You are the person on the floor who turns capacity plans into operational reality.



As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, you will execute structured cabling, rack installation, and decommission activities with precision and to standard — following established SOPs, escalating deviations to your team lead, and ensuring every rack you touch is installed correctly, cabled to specification, fully documented, and handed off with zero blockers. This is an individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities. Your work is foundational to AWS’s ability to deliver infrastructure capacity to customers reliably, safely, and at the lowest possible cost.



Key job responsibilities Rack Installation \& Cabling


* Execute rack installations including physical placement, power connections, grounding, and cable management per AWS standards and MOPs
* Perform structured cabling including fiber/copper terminations, patch panel connections, labeling, and dressing to specification
* Complete OTDR and power testing; validate results against acceptance thresholds; escalate failures to team lead promptly rather than self\-resolving outside approved procedures
* Follow all EHS protocols, lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures, and safe work practices during installation activities


 Rack Lifecycle Operations


* Execute work orders and tasks assigned by the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager under direct manager direction, maintaining accurate status updates in workflow management tools (e.g., Boost, MARS)
* Perform quality checks on completed cabling work including port map verification, label accuracy, and as\-built documentation updates in CMDB/DCIM
* Identify and escalate issues, blockers, or deviations from SOPs encountered during task execution to the team lead or manager promptly; do not self\-resolve outside approved procedures
* Support deployment wave readiness by participating in pre\-work site walks, material staging, and tool preparation


 Material Handling \& Supply Chain Support


* Receive, verify, and stage incoming rack, cable, optics, and hardware deliveries; validate against BOM and flag discrepancies
* Maintain accurate site inventory records for cables, optics, patch cords, and consumables used during deployments
* Support cycle count activities and assist in identifying inventory shortfalls that may impact deployment timelines


 Handover \& Documentation


* Complete all required as\-built documentation, port maps, test result records, and workflow sign\-offs before handoff to Data Center Operations
* Update CMDB/DCIM and IPAM records accurately following rack installation or decommission activities
* Ensure handoffs are clean and fully documented with zero open blockers, enabling smooth transition to the next lifecycle phase


 Rack Decommissioning


* Execute physical decommission activities per assigned MOPs — including cable removal, power disconnects, asset de\-tagging, and rack extraction
* Perform device wipe and media destruction in compliance with AWS Secure Media Destruction and EHS policies
* Sort, label, and stage recovered assets (optics, cables, PDUs, hardware) for RMA, redeployment, or secure disposal per AWS Reverse Logistics policy
* Update DCIM/CMDB, IPAM, and port maps post\-decom to ensure accurate space, power, and circuit records
* Validate that reclaimed U\-space, power, and cooling capacity is accurately recorded in the available pool


 Quality, Safety \& Compliance


* Adhere to all site\-level SOPs, quality standards, and governance frameworks for cabling, installation, and decommission activities
* Complete all required safety training and certifications; participate in regular EHS audits and team safety briefings
* Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying recurring quality issues, suggesting process improvements, and sharing feedback with the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager
* Use Rack Lifecycle Team tooling (e.g., Boost, MARS, ALM/DCLM) accurately to record work, track assets, and maintain data integrity


 Cross\-Team Coordination


* Support coordination with DCO, DCEO, Network Engineering, and facilities teams during active deployment or decom activities under manager guidance to ensure smooth execution
* Participate in daily stand\-ups and pre\-work briefings; communicate clearly on task status, blockers, and schedule adherence
* Provide accurate, timely updates on task completion and flag risks or delays to the team lead immediately


 Continuous Learning \& Development


* Maintain and develop technical proficiency in structured cabling, fiber optics, rack installation, and data center physical infrastructure
* Complete required certifications and training modules including EHS, LOTO, and any Rack Lifecycle Team\-specific technical programs
* Proactively seek feedback from leads and managers to improve personal performance and output quality
* Support the onboarding and training of new team members; share knowledge and best practices with peers to build overall team capability and quality standards
* Stay current on AWS infrastructure tooling, cabling standards, and process updates communicated by the Rack Lifecycle Team


A day in the life As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, your day is on the data center floor. You might start the morning by reviewing your assigned work orders in Boost, checking in with your team lead on priorities, and staging cables and optics for a rack installation wave. By midday, you could be terminating fiber runs at a patch panel, running OTDR tests to validate loss results against acceptance thresholds, or labeling and dressing a freshly installed rack. In the afternoon, you might be updating CMDB records for completed work orders, de\-tagging and staging recovered assets from an EOL decom, or helping onboard a new technician by walking them through the SOP. If you encounter a deviation from the approved MOP, you escalate it to your team lead immediately — you don't improvise. Your role is hands\-on, technical, and precise — you execute the work that keeps AWS capacity on track.

### **Job Description**



Coordinate with design, production, procurement, and product testing teams to validate cost\-optimized solutions for existing and new products under VAVE (Value Analysis and Value Engineering) initiatives. ### **Job Description**



Lead and coordinate with design, production, procurement, and product testing teams to validate cost\-optimized solutions for existing and new products under VAVE (Value Analysis and Value Engineering) initiatives. The primary responsibility is to ensure reliability, functional integrity, and certification compliance after implementing VAVE changes. This role requires validating design and component modifications through structured testing, automation programs, and compliance assessments. ### **Key Responsibilities**


* Perform testing and validation of VAVE\-related design and component changes in power supply products, modules, and systems.

* Collaborate with design, procurement, reliability, and compliance teams to verify cost\-optimized solutions without affecting performance.
* Ensure all VAVE changes comply with UL, CE, and other international safety and certification standards.
* Prepare detailed test reports, risk analysis, and recommendations for each VAVE implementation.

* Knowledge of safety certification processes (UL, CE) preferred.
