title: Associate Systems Support Engineer
description:
**Experience:** 2–5 Years
  

**Notice Period :** 15 days Max or Immediate Joiners Only


**Communication Skills :** Mandatory excellent communication skills in English


**Employment Type:** Full\-Time
  

**Work Mode:** On\-site / Hybrid, as applicable, 24X7 rotational Shifts.
  

**Shift:** Standard business hours with occasional after\-hours/on\-call support as required


**Job Summary**

We are looking for a hands\-on **Tier 2 Windows Support Engineer** to join our Infrastructure Support team. The engineer will be responsible for day\-to\-day administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, maintenance, and support of Windows Server environments.


The role will primarily focus on **Windows Server, patching, monitoring, incident management, and operational support** .


The candidate should be comfortable independently troubleshooting common infrastructure issues and working with Tier 1, Tier 3, Network, Database, Security, and other infrastructure teams when escalation is required.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Windows Server Administration**

* Provide Tier 2 support for Windows Server environments.
* Administration and troubleshooting of Windows Server 2016/2019/2022\.
* Perform server health checks and investigate performance\-related issues.
* Troubleshoot CPU, memory, disk, service, event log, and OS\-related issues.
* Start/stop/restart Windows services as required.
* Troubleshoot server connectivity and application/service availability issues.

**Patching \& Maintenance**

* Perform Windows Server patching activities according to the approved patching schedule.
* Validate server health before and after patching.
* Troubleshoot patching failures.
* Perform post\-patching validation.
* Maintain patching records and update operational documentation.
* Support vulnerability remediation activities related to Windows servers.

**Monitoring \& Incident Management**

* Monitor Windows server infrastructure using enterprise monitoring tools.
* Investigate and resolve alerts within defined SLAs.
* Handle Tier 2 incidents and service requests.
* Perform initial troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis.
* Escalate complex or recurring issues to Tier 3 teams.
* Maintain accurate ticket updates and technical documentation.
* Participate in Problem Management and Change Management activities.

**Documentation \& Process**

* Maintain server documentation and operational procedures.
* Update Knowledge Base articles and troubleshooting guides.
* Follow ITIL\-based Incident, Request, Change, and Problem Management processes.
* Participate in operational reviews and provide status updates.
* Maintain accurate records of infrastructure changes and activities.

**Required Technical Skills**

**Must Have**

* 2–5 years of experience in Windows Server administration/support.
* Hands\-on experience with Windows Server 2016/2019/2022\.
* Good knowledge of Active Directory.
* Good understanding of Group Policy.
* Working knowledge of DNS and DHCP.
* Experience troubleshooting Windows Server issues.
* Understanding of TCP/IP and basic networking concepts.
* Experience with server patching and maintenance.
* Experience working with ITSM/ticketing tools such as ServiceNow.
Good incident troubleshooting and documentation skills.  
* 

  

**Good to Have**

* Basic PowerShell scripting.
* Knowledge of monitoring tools.
* Experience with WSUS/MECM/SCCM.
* ITIL Foundation certification.

**Candidate Profile**

We are looking for someone who:


* Has strong troubleshooting ability rather than only theoretical knowledge.
* Can independently handle common Windows Server incidents.
* Is comfortable working in a structured IT operations environment.
* Understands SLA\-based support.
* Has good written and verbal communication skills.
* Can work effectively with L1, L3, Network, Database, Security, and Application teams.
* Is willing to take ownership of incidents until resolution or appropriate escalation.
* Is comfortable working with documented processes and change controls.

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.


Relevant hands\-on experience may be considered in lieu of formal qualifications.


**Certifications**

Certifications are **preferred but not mandatory** .


Examples:


* Microsoft Windows Server / Microsoft certifications
* Azure Fundamentals
* ITIL Foundation

description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior Network Engineer
Overview  

* Supports and assists with the design, architecture, implementation, security and support of a multi\-site network communication environment.

  

Role  

  

Responsibilities:  

  

* Manage and implement a range of network projects.
* Develop detailed requirements for upgrading existing production, corporate and non\-production network devices.
* Participates in the planning and implementing upgrading existing production and corporate and non\-production network devices.
* Completes network communications troubleshooting and provides in\-depth technical assistance with operational problems.
* Supports assigned projects, which include responsibility for planning, time, resource utilization and implementation of changes (in and out of core hours). Identifying risks relating to the project, escalating potential concerns, and helping to prevent further design updates and missed requirements. Including:
* Cross\-team collaboration and engagement with different teams to obtain the necessary information to complete the project and overcome obstacles.
* Engagement with the change process and operations management.
* Supports Vendor management.
* Identifies service improvement activities that would optimise the network's performance, efficiency, and capacity.
* Performs baseline checks on new hardware to ensure it complies with company standards and aligns with the current security posture.
* Support peers with knowledge sharing and reviewing work

  

All About You  

Experiences  

* Three to five years of overall IT experience in the following areas:
* Networking, including LAN/WAN
* Firewalls
* Security and encryption technologies
* Load Balancing
* Experience with TCP/IP protocol communications.
* Broad knowledge of Cisco’s product portfolio.
* Knowledge of Network diagnostics, BGP, SNMP, VPN, SSH, MPLS technologies.
* Work in a heavily regulated environment with DSS/PCI compliance.

  

Skills/ Abilities:  

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Self\-starter with demonstrated listening skills.
* Serves as a mentor to lower\-level employees, leads others, and uses good judgment.
* Limited supervision: work may be reviewed for direction and strategy.
* Ability to identify and formulate a plan to implement improvements in line with colleagues' agreement when completing work.
* Holds a current CCNP certification or equivalent experience.

  

Work Conditions:  

* Supports a 24 by 7 Global Network.
* May require occasional travel.
* Hybrid Working

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Application Engineer III
description:
**Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team**  

As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.  

  

We are a **Great Place To Work\-Certified** organization. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!

**What we offer:**

* Competitive salary
* Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
* On the job/cross training opportunities
* Encouraging and collaborative team environment
* Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

**What you will do**


The primary responsibility for this role is to support pre\-sales engineering for Building Automation System global projects as per country specific standards. Handling daily routine activities related to presales estimation support by preparing technical assessments. Basic knowledge about bill of material preparation, cost estimation to come up with competitive bid. Follow processes, maintain required quality standards and on time deliveries to ensure customer satisfaction.

**How you will do it**

* Review project inputs and specifications; should be able to capture the scope and understand the complete requirements of the project.
* Review MEP drawings, specification, SOP and identify HVAC equipment, dampers and sensors.
* Preparation and participation for project kick\-off / review meetings with technical queries, compliance / deviations log, risk logs and record minutes of meeting.
* Adherence to standard estimation process and guideline to select proper combination of hardware, software, equipment, materials and services to come up with the optimum budget.
* Creation of bill of material, selection of sensors, control valves, dampers, air flow stations, controllers etc.
* Preparation of Building Automation System network architecture
* Ensure quality assurance, defect free deliverables and on time deliveries.
* Ensure timesheet compliance with respect to entry and review for self.

**What we look for**

* BE/ME (Instrumentation / Electrical/ Electronics / Electronics \& Communication.
* Knowledge of HVAC systems like Chilled Water System, Cooling Towers, Primary \& Secondary pumping systems, Hot Water System, Different types of AHUs, FCUs, VAV systems etc.
* Strong knowledge of BMS architecture with different types of Operator workstations, Supervisory Controllers, DDC controllers, Sensors \& Actuators etc.
* Knowledge of different types of network protocols like BACNet, LON, Modbus, OPC, and other protocols.
* Must be proficient in wiring of starters, field devices, safety interlocks \& panels.
* Experience in engineering, installing and commissioning of HVAC \& BMS systems for infrastructure projects like pharmaceuticals, airports, commercial buildings, hospitals.
* Experience in the field of Automation (PLC programming/SCADA).
* Must be a quick learner \& should have a keen eye for problem solving.
* Proficient in written and verbal communication.
* Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills.

**Preferred**


5\+ years of relevant experience in Building Automation Industry, BMS Design Engineering.
